rdfs:label: Profile
rdfs:comment: An ActivityStreams Object that describes another Object — typically supplemental information about an Actor (a richer biography, alternate display data) layered on top of the actor's primary record.
notes: A Profile uses `as:describes` to point at the Object it documents. Useful when the descriptive payload is large or evolves independently of the actor's identity record (e.g. a long bio with media attachments) — the Profile is fetched separately and may be cached, signed, or replicated apart from the Actor.

examples.title: A Profile that describes an Actor
